mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the phenomenon in which electrons are emitted from matter due to irradiation by electromagnetic waves of suitable frequency.
Photoelectric effect is the phenomenon in which electrons are emitted from matter due to irradiation by electromagnetic waves of suitable frequency.
Fill in the blank: ______ are the possible values a measurement will yield, and the eigenstates are the possible states we can find the system.
The eigenvalues are the possible values a measurement will yield, and the eigenstates are the possible states we can find the system.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the perfect absorber and emitter of radiation.
A blackbody is the perfect absorber and emitter of radiation.
fib: ______ is the foundational material for a good understanding of electronics.

A postulate is a something that is assumed to be self-evident, requiring no proof, used as a basis for reasoning.
